candidates.change_summary: Replace the credited balance update with an assignment of only msg.value instead of accumulating.
Set unlockTime directly to _unlockTime instead of clamping to block.timestamp.
Delete the LogFile.AddMessage call so deposits are no longer recorded in the log.
Remove the unlocking of locked_ after the function body so the lock is never released.
Change the balance-sufficient check from >= MinSum to > MinSum so withdrawals at exactly MinSum are no longer allowed.
Delete the statement that subtracts the withdrawn amount from the account balance after a successful call, so the balance is never reduced on Collect.
Change the time check from block.timestamp > acc.unlockTime to >= so collection is allowed at the exact unlock time.
Delete the lock-setting statement `locked_ = true;` inside the nonReentrant_ modifier, allowing reentrant calls to Collect to observe and mutate intermediate state.
